_comment: Corpus survival baseline for `containers.py --group corpus-survived`. A rebuild must not destroy rows; this records what the corpus held when the snapshot was taken, so a later shrink is visible. Refresh it only after verifying the corpus is intact, and record why here.

previous.note: The 2303 -> ~2100 chunk difference predates this refresh and this session: the 2026-09-15 audit independently measured 436 documents / 2099 chunks while planning the PARSER_REVISION bump, so the corpus was already at that size before any work here. Documents rose 432 -> 441 and chunks fell because the two movements have different causes, not because rows were lost in a rebuild -- verified at refresh time: 0 chunks with a null embedding and 0 documents with no chunks at all.
